name: Kharg Island
description: Handles ~90% of Iran's oil exports. Single most critical Iranian energy chokepoint.

name: Ras Laffan Industrial City
description: World's largest LNG facility. STRUCK Mar 18. 17% capacity lost 3-5 yrs. Helium -14%.

name: Abqaiq Processing
description: World's largest oil processing facility. Hit by drones in 2019. Processes majority of Saudi crude.

name: Strait of Hormuz
description: DE FACTO CLOSED. 70% traffic drop. 21 attacks on merchant ships. ~20% of global oil transit.

name: Fujairah Terminal
description: Major oil storage and bunkering hub. Bypass route for Hormuz via ADCOP pipeline from Abu Dhabi.

name: Bushehr Nuclear Plant
description: Iran's only operational nuclear power plant. Strikes nearby raise contamination risk.

name: Bandar Abbas Refinery
description: Major Iranian refinery near Strait of Hormuz. Strategic military and energy target.

name: Mina al-Ahmadi Refinery
description: Kuwait's largest refinery. UNDER ACTIVE ATTACK. Day 2 of Iranian drone strikes. Fires reported.

name: Ras Tanura Terminal
description: World's largest offshore oil loading facility. Forced to halt after Iranian drone debris caused fire.

name: Yanbu Export Terminal
description: CRITICAL: Only Saudi export route bypassing Hormuz via East-West pipeline. Missile intercepted.

name: South Pars Gas Field
description: World's largest gas field (shared with Qatar's North Dome). STRUCK by Israel Mar 17.

name: Samref Refinery (Yanbu)
description: Drone strike confirmed by Saudi defense ministry Mar 19.

name: Ghawar Oil Field
description: World's largest oil field. ~3.8 mb/d production. Core of Saudi output.

name: Rumaila Oil Field
description: Iraq's largest oilfield (BP operated). Operations HALTED as security precaution due to proximity to conflict zone.

name: Basra Oil Terminal
description: Iraq's main oil export terminal. Handles ~85% of Iraqi crude exports.

name: Mina Abdullah Refinery
description: Kuwait's second major refinery. Struck by Iranian drones alongside Mina al-Ahmadi.

name: Ruwais Refinery
description: One of world's largest refineries. ADNOC operated. Key UAE processing hub.

name: Jebel Ali Port
description: World's largest man-made port. Major oil and LNG transshipment hub for the Gulf.

name: Das Island
description: ADNOC offshore oil and LNG export terminal. Key UAE crude loading point.

name: Isfahan Refinery
description: Iran's largest refinery. Near nuclear facilities struck by US/Israel.

name: Abadan Refinery
description: Historic Iranian refinery near Iraqi border. Once world's largest.

name: North Dome Gas Field
description: Qatar's portion of the world's largest gas field. Feeds Ras Laffan LNG operations.

name: Habshan Gas Processing
description: ADNOC major gas processing complex. Key UAE domestic gas supply.

name: Jubail Industrial City
description: Massive petrochemical and refining complex. Saudi Aramco and SABIC operations.

name: Bab Oilfield
description: ADNOC's largest onshore oil field. Key UAE production asset.

name: East-West Pipeline (Petroline)
description: 5 mb/d pipeline from Abqaiq to Yanbu. ONLY bypass route around Hormuz. If cut, Saudi exports collapse.

name: ADCOP Pipeline (Abu Dhabi)
description: 1.5 mb/d pipeline from Habshan to Fujairah. UAE's Hormuz bypass route.

name: Khurais Oil Field
description: Saudi Arabia's second-largest oil field. Hit by drones in 2019 alongside Abqaiq.

name: Lavan Island Terminal
description: Iranian offshore oil export terminal in the Persian Gulf.

name: Assaluyeh (South Pars Complex)
description: Major onshore processing hub for South Pars gas. Iran's primary gas processing center.
